Name: Taelende's Void Ranch for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Permissions for Taelende's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2696]Void Ranch[/url] were open, so I've taken the liberty of updating it to 1.6!

This mod adds {not replaces!) void versions of all the vanilla animals. They include:

Coop:
4 varieties of Fancy Void Chickens
A Void Duck
A Void Rabbit
A Void Dinosaur

Barn:
2 varieties of Void Cow
A Void Sheep
A Void Goat
A Void Pig

All these animals can be purchased from Marnie. The cows, goats, chickens and dino produce vanilla milks and eggs, and the pig digs up truffles like vanilla pigs. The duck lays a vanilla egg but drops a void feather. The sheep and rabbits will provide void wool that can be turned into void cloth, and rabbits drop void rabbit's feet with high friendship.

This mod does NOT include the horse from the original since that was a retexture of the vanilla horse and not a barn or coop animal.

Enjoy!
